acceptance: No worktree or scratch file from this work remains, and nothing unpushed was lost.
context: Filed 2026-11-20 from the adversarial review of the scale-factor and TPC-DI remediation work (PRs #4298-#4385 and benchbox-site #178-#210).
description:
## Problem
Worktrees wt-heavyguard, wt-ci-diag, wt-doris-lakesail, wt-tpcds-scale-bounds, wt-fastgate, wt-fast-baseline-review, wt-pr-rerun-msg, wt-fast-baseline-4381 and site worktrees wt-tpcds-scale-bounds and wt-read-model-20 remain, with scratch under /tmp (hg-b4, b5, fdrc*, tuat, scale-remediation, rv, audit) and ~/.cache (closeout.sh, arm-*.log, rerun-*.log, preflight-*.log and others).

## Change
Remove each worktree with `make worktree-remove` once its pull request is merged or closed; delete scratch. Keep /tmp/fdrc* until fast-duration-gate-runner-class-spread-20261120 has its method recorded.

## Decision gates
Never remove a worktree with unpushed commits or uncommitted changes without listing them to the owner first. Do not delete anything under ~/Developer/benchmark_runs.

## Verification rubric
Pass: `git worktree list` shows none of the named worktrees; the named scratch paths are gone.

## Guardrails
- Any limit, default, threshold or label text is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- The implementer never resolves review threads on its own pull request; the reviewer or the owner does.
- No polling loop around `make pr-arm`, no `--no-verify`, and no stand-in review unless the owner names the PR and head unprompted.
- Heavy work runs only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking entry point.
- Status reports state only what merged and what was verified, with the evidence.
